scenario_definitions.name: nominal
scenario_definitions.description: Known initial roll, constant bias, matched noise, and uniform timestamps.

scenario_definitions.name: initial_offset
scenario_definitions.description: Initial roll is 60 deg with a declared 30 deg model standard deviation.

scenario_definitions.name: initial_overconfident
scenario_definitions.description: Initial roll is 60 deg with zero initial angle covariance.

scenario_definitions.name: bias_ramp
scenario_definitions.description: True bias rises from 0.5 to 1.5 deg/s over 10 to 20 s.

scenario_definitions.name: accel_dropout
scenario_definitions.description: Accelerometer observations are unavailable for 12 <= arrival time < 17 s.

scenario_definitions.name: timing_jitter
scenario_definitions.description: Positive interval durations vary while preserving 3000 intervals over 30 s.

scenario_definitions.name: accel_noise_mismatch
scenario_definitions.description: Actual acceleration noise is 0.6 m/s^2; nominal filter tuning is unchanged.

scenario_definitions.name: accel_delay
scenario_definitions.description: Accelerometer samples arrive 0.1 s after acquisition; the runner ignores that delay.

random_generator: SeedSequence children gyro/accel/jitter -> uint64 seeds -> Generator(PCG64)

acceptance.scope: nominal accuracy only; numerical contracts on every case

limitations: Fixed cases and seeds do not establish general robustness or estimator ranking.
Bias is fixed in every filter, including when the true bias ramps.
Delay source times are known only to simulation; estimators apply observations at arrival.
Gyro samples are exact interval means, not logged snapshots or a continuous noise density.
Covariance and NIS are model diagnostics, not calibrated accuracy guarantees.
No new physical acquisition, C++ parity, embedded, or flight validation is demonstrated.
